free_text: Biopsy is recommended due to the high PI-RADS 5 finding, which is the decisive factor aligning with the cohort criterion. This is supported by the established high csPCa predicted probability of 0.84823215 and the rising PSA trend culminating at 15.8 ng/mL. The evidence converged on biopsy because the retrieved MRI finding and the established risk profile comprehensively satisfy the criteria outlined in the panel protocol and the EAU guideline.
